verdict.rationale: LiteLLM's proxy documents its own virtual keys, per-key and per-team budgets, and team creation. The team payload snippet with team_alias and rpm_limit implies JSON admin API calls, but the evidence never names explicit admin endpoints for generating keys or setting budgets. YAML config and an admin UI cover part of the same ground, and nothing shows gateways or deployments being provisioned programmatically. Missing for 10: explicit documented key/budget admin API endpoints, programmatic gateway/deployment provisioning, a published OpenAPI spec for the admin API, and independent hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can provision gateways, keys, and budgets programmatically through an admin API
